findings.detail: The GCOM warrant with fair value 252 thousand is absent from the extracted position sum.
Short-term investments with fair value 47.526 million are omitted from conservation scope; together with the warrant they exactly explain the 47.778 million residual.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation supports the filing total. The schedule reports total investments of 203.856 million (table 13 row 65), independently repeated as total assets in the fair-value hierarchy (table 60 row 11), while the extracted sum is 156.078 million. The 47.778 million shortfall equals the 47.526 million short-term-investment subtotal plus the 0.252 million GCOM warrant exactly. The source therefore localizes the conservation failure to omitted positions/scope, not an erroneous schedule anchor.
